paragraphs.text: PhotoGroupe is a web-based image-sharing and photographer booking platform built to close a gap left by existing platforms like Pinterest, Instagram, Flickr, and Behance: none of them let a client discover, verify, negotiate with, and pay a professional photographer inside one integrated system. PhotoGroupe combines Pinterest-style image sharing (pins, categories, albums, likes, comments) with a full photographer booking workflow profile verification, availability, real-time chat negotiation, escrow-based payments via eSewa, and an event-request bidding module where photographers compete for client jobs.
